-- What a client importing `Proof.github_com.mit_pdos.etcd_grove.examples.lib.etcdstart.WalAreasInit` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

def etcdWalAreasInit (st : Fs.OsState) (Ds : List GoString) : Prop :=
  ∀ (d : GoString),
    d ∈ Ds →
      (∃ n, d = memberDataDir n) ∧
        (∃ j, (walAreaOf d, j) ∈ st.fs.roots ∧ ∀ (b : GoString), WalFs.AreaSlot b → st.fs.treeDur.entry j b = none) ∧
          ∃ j, (d, j) ∈ st.fs.roots ∧ ∀ (b : GoString), st.fs.treeDur.entry j b = none
